 Print this Article 
 View Comments Paul George and Jayson Tatum got plenty of rest and a few laughs in the fourth quarter of Sunday's win over Dallas. Jessica Rinaldi/Globe Staff After rolling over the Mavericks, 131-94 , on Sunday night, the Celtics will look to extend their winning streak to seven when they face the Magic on the second of a back-to-back set. 
 The Celtics jumped out to a 42-9 lead against Dallas and never looked back. Only Jayson Tatum (30:08) played more than 25 minutes, so there may not be the usual concerns that come with playing on consecutive nights. 
 It’s the second meeting between the teams this month following the Celtics’ 108-97 win at Orlando Nov. 1 . 
 Tonight’s game will stream on Peacock and NBC Sports Network, which is not the same as NBC Sports Boston. The linear cable and satellite channel, which was revived in November 2025 after a four-year hiatus, is not available everywhere. In the Boston market, NBCSN is carried by Xfinity (channel 1210), YouTube TV, and FuboTV. 
 Get Court Sense Keep up with everything Celtics with news, commentary, and analysis from the Globe's all-star team. Arrives twice weekly. Enter Email Sign Up When: Monday, 7 p.m. 
 Where: TD Garden, Boston 
 TV: NBCSN, Peacock. Radio: WBZ-FM 98.5. 
 Line: Boston -8.5. O/U: 212.5. 
 MAGIC 
 Season record: 5-7. vs. spread: 5-7. Over/under: 5-7 
 Last 10 games: 5-5. vs. spread: 5-5. Over/under: 4-6 
 CELTICS 
 Season record: 11-2. vs. spread: 8-4, 1 push. Over/under: 5-7, 1 push 
 Last 10 games: 9-1. vs. spread: 6-3, 1 push. Over/under: 4-6 
 TEAM STATISTICS 
 Points per game: Orlando 108.3, Boston 115.5 
 Points allowed per game: Orlando 112.8, Boston 102.4 
 Field goal percentage: Orlando .448, Boston .460 
 Opponent field goal percentage: Orlando .466, Boston .417 
 3-point percentage: Orlando .337, Boston .385 
 Opponent 3-point percentage: Orlando .380, Boston .338 
 Stat of the day: The Celtics had 10 players make at least one 3-pointer in Sunday’s win. They were 23 of 55 from 3-point range. 
 Notes: The Celtics are 2-1 when playing the second of back-to-back games this season, most recently following up last Tuesday’s win at Philadelphia by rallying to defeat the Raptors the next night. … The Celtics’ 42-9 lead Sunday was their largest lead after 12 minutes in franchise history. … Tatum had 32 points when the teams met two weeks ago. … Franz Wagner was held to 14 points, but has scored at least 30 points in each of his last four games. He had 35 points, 12 assists and nine rebounds in 36 minutes to help Orlando extend its winning streak to three games with a 107-99 victory over the Bucks on Friday night. … Jordan Walsh, credited by Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla with taking the lead in slowing Cooper Flagg Sunday, could draw the assignment of guarding Wagner. … After tonight’s game, the Celtics will hit the road for a four-game swing beginning in Denver Wednesday.
